seoTitle: How to View & Set Up Your Instagram Professional Dashboard
metaDescription: Access the Instagram Professional Dashboard, set up a payout account through PayPal or another method, and start receiving ad revenue.
intro: The Professional Dashboard is where Creator and Business accounts manage monetization, insights, and payout settings on Instagram. This guide covers finding the dashboard and setting up a payout account so ad revenue can be deposited automatically.

steps.heading: Open the Professional Dashboard
steps.body: Tap your Profile icon, then the menu icon in the top right, and select Professional Dashboard — available only on Creator or Business accounts.

steps.heading: Navigate to payout setup
steps.body: Scroll down and tap Set Up Payout Account, or go to Settings, Business/Creator, Monetization, then Payouts.

steps.heading: Log in with Facebook if prompted
steps.body: You may need to log in using your linked Facebook account to continue the payout setup process.

steps.heading: Choose and link a payout method
steps.body: Select a payout method such as PayPal, follow the prompts to link the account, and complete the setup.

faq.question: Do I need a Business or Creator account to see the Professional Dashboard?
faq.answer: Yes, the Professional Dashboard is only available for Creator or Business accounts, not standard personal accounts.

faq.question: What payout methods can I use?
faq.answer: Instagram supports payout options such as PayPal, set up through the Monetization and Payouts section of your dashboard.

faq.question: Do I need to manually withdraw my earnings?
faq.answer: No, once your payout account is set up, ad revenue is generally deposited automatically without a manual withdrawal step.

faq.question: Why do I need to log in with Facebook to set up payouts?
faq.answer: Instagram's payout setup is tied to Facebook's account system, so you may be prompted to log in with Facebook to continue.
